title: Putting Montreal on the
map for technical recruitment
map.sub: QUARCC is an environment of top talent and a pipeline to placements. Members earn their seats at quant firms the way researchers do — through research and projects that hold up.

pillars.label: 01 / Build
pillars.title: Research & projects
pillars.body: The most technically unique projects in Montreal — published research, open-source repositories and models rebuilt from first principles.

pillars.label: 02 / Compete
pillars.title: Competitions
pillars.body: Club teams take on quant competitions and hackathons across North America — and place.

pillars.label: 03 / Place
pillars.title: Placements
pillars.body: A direct line to quant firms, market makers, banks, startups and research labs — earned through the work above.

audience.label: Who it's for
audience.text: Students who are into quant, willing to give time, and want the placement that comes from real work.
